record.original_question: Let phi be a bounded plurisubharmonic function on a domain Omega contained in C^n. When (phi_j) is any sequence of bounded plurisubharmonic functions converging to phi in L^1_loc, determine what can be said about the set of cluster points of the Monge-Ampere measures (dd^c phi_j)^n.

evidence.quote: Question 2 (Bedford). Given phi a bounded plurisubharmonic function in some domain Omega subset C^n, what can be said about the set of cluster points of (dd^c phi_j)^n, where phi_j are bounded plurisubharmonic functions which converge to phi in L^1_loc ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a domain and let $\varphi : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ be a bounded plurisubharmonic function. For a bounded plurisubharmonic function $u$ on $\Omega$, the Bedford–Taylor complex Monge–Ampère measure $(dd^c u)^n$ is well defined as a positive Radon measure on $\Omega$, where $d = \partial + \bar\partial$ and $d^c = \frac{i}{2\pi}(\bar\partial - \partial)$.

Consider all sequences $(\varphi_j)$ of bounded plurisubharmonic functions on $\Omega$ such that $\varphi_j \to \varphi$ in $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega)$. Let
$$\mathcal{C}(\varphi) = \big\{ \mu : \mu \text{ is a weak-}\!*\text{ cluster point of } \big((dd^c \varphi_j)^n\big) \text{ for some such sequence } (\varphi_j) \big\}.$$

Characterize the set $\mathcal{C}(\varphi)$: describe which positive Radon measures on $\Omega$ can arise as weak-$*$ cluster points of Monge–Ampère measures of bounded plurisubharmonic approximations to $\varphi$ in $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question, attributed to Bedford, concerns characterizing cluster points of complex Monge–Ampère measures under $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$ approximation by bounded plurisubharmonic functions. The Monge–Ampère operator is known to be discontinuous in the $L^1$ topology, and partial results exist (continuity under monotone or quasi-monotone convergence, criteria for non-pluripolar weak convergence), but a complete characterization of the cluster set even for bounded $\varphi$ does not appear in the literature. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Quasi-monotone convergence of plurisubharmonic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Provides convergence criteria for Monge-Ampère measures under quasi-monotone (stronger than L^1) convergence.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial convergence results under stronger-than-L^1 hypotheses are known.

status_evidence.title: Plurisubharmonic functions with discontinuous boundary behavior
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Bedford's questions on cluster points of (dd^c phi_j)^n for approximating sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Bedford's questions about cluster points of Monge–Ampère measures are still discussed as open problems.

status_evidence.title: Weak Continuity of Complex Monge-Ampère Operators on Compact Hermitian Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Provides a criterion for weak convergence of non-pluripolar complex Monge-Ampère measures.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work gives only sufficient criteria for weak convergence, not a full characterization of cluster points.
